        # 1. Count the number of Heads (1s)

        # 2. Check stopping condition

        # 3. Increment turn count
        turns += 1

        # 4. Flip the k-th coin (k is 1-indexed, so index is k-1)
        # The operation is to flip the k-th coin over.
        # H (1) -> T (0)
        # T (0) -> H (1)
